defect.message: The girder is described as "Steel plate girders acting compositely with a 0.25 m cast-in-place deck slab, ... steel Q345", i.e. a composite steel-plate-girder section. The knowledge graph only covers concrete girders: the section-geometry schema offers only small_box / t_girder / cast_box, the modeling rule MR-02 computes A and I from a concrete cross-section ("外轮廓减内孔"), and the material rules (e.g. JTG3362-3.1.5, EC_TABLE) apply only to concrete grades. There is no rule, clause, section type or material model for steel plate girders or for a composite steel-girder/concrete-deck section, so the girder cannot be modelled within the scope of the KG.
